title: i3blocks: shadow-week leisure block (leisure_shadow.sh)
objective: Render daily-limits' `leisure_shadow` cache (contract C5) as `🛋 SHADOW <left> left · <used> used`, yellow under 30 min, red `🛋 SHADOW WOULD BLOCK · <used> used` at 0, never urgent.
acceptance_criteria: null/absent numbers render `🛋 SHADOW ⏱? no data`, never 0
the block always exits 0 and prints exactly three lines
out_of_scope: Renaming the gaming block or its labels (Phase 2)
Any accounting: the numbers come from steam-backlog-enforcer via daily-limits
verifier: the test script above, shellcheck, and the block run against a forced fixture cache
